source: Poole 2022, Palaeontologia Electronica 25, Fig. 8: time-calibrated Bayesian tree of ornithischians (ornithopods) against a period and epoch chart; rectangular, root left, posterior probabilities beside the nodes, clade names beside node dots or joined to them by curved arrows. Image: census 2 figure (1952x2259 px), a 300 dpi page render of the vector figure.
attribution: Poole, K. E. (2022). Phylogeny of iguanodontian dinosaurs and the evolution of quadrupedality. Palaeontologia Electronica. https://doi.org/10.26879/702. Fig. 8. CC BY 4.0.
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names, including 'Shishugou taxon', 'Kirkwood taxon', 'Barilium holotype', 'Mantellisaurus holotype' and the specimen tip 'RBINS R57'
gold_note: Ornithopod time tree, read from the PDF's own vector branch lines (one line width, 268 segments) and checked against the figure: 68 tips in printed order, every node binary. Thirteen clade names at node dots are kept as internal labels (Neornithischia, Clypeodonta, Hypsilophodontidae, Thescelosauridae, Iguanodontia, Rhabdodontoidea, Rhabdodontidae, Dryomorpha, Dryosauridae, Ankylopollexia, Styracosterna, Iguanodontidae, Hadrosauroidea); 'Unnamed node' is not a name and is not encoded, nor are the probabilities. 68 tips, fully resolved; 13 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 6 case (census 2 extended to draw 120, seed 20261231). Topology read from the PDF's own vector branch lines and checked against the figure; topology only.
